turns.assessment: svc278 failed in the first event at about t=602.5, not in the later t=660 OCM event. Its S03–S21 segment remained healthy for several other services, while the S16–S03 channel receiver at S03 (trx.och66.z) lost optical power and raised OCH_LOS. The S16 transmitter, span amplifiers, and S03 input OCM remained unchanged, localizing the loss after the OCM inside S03; simultaneous channel losses and unaffected channels on other degrees favor a failed WSS input port rather than a receiver or fibre fault.

proposals.rationale: A failed S03 WSS input port can block all channels arriving on the affected degree. It explains receiver-side optical loss despite normal upstream transmission, amplifier powers, and input OCM readings, as well as the broad group of services lost through the affected lightpaths.

proposals.rationale: An extreme channel attenuation drift after the OCM could produce the observed loss, but the simultaneous impact to multiple channels is much more consistent with a port failure.

clarify.assessment: The evidence identifies the S16-facing input port at S03. The S16→S03 lightpath receiver trx.och66.z at S03 lost signal, while the S16→S03 amplifiers and the input channel monitor S03:oms.S16-S03 showed no change. This localizes the block after the monitored OMS input, at oms.S16-S03|port.
